coverage_blockers: The source packet contains no article PDF, JATS/XML, accepted manuscript, supplement, or full-text HTML.
The public JAMA Neurology page exposes the structured abstract but gates the article body and PDF behind an access flow.
Main-text figures, tables, detailed methods, full limitations, funding/disclosure details, and the bibliography could not be inspected.
Whole-source ATOM completeness, full SEA coverage reconciliation, and a reference-by-reference task queue therefore cannot be certified.
validation_boundary: The current project Pydantic model, atom sufficiency validator, and JSON Schema were executed directly. Passing validation means the extracted abstract-level atoms are structurally and kind-sufficiently valid. It does not mean whole-source extraction is complete.
review_status: All atoms remain needs_review; no human verification was fabricated.
